ACT V OF 1991
ACT V OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE ESTABLISHMENT OF DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT
ADVISORY COMMITTEES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Establishment
of District Development Advisory Committees Act, 1989
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/91/5136, dated
26-3-1991: --The North-West Frontier Province District Development Advisory
Committee (Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of the North-West Frontier Province on the 12th March, 1991 and assented to by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 21st March, 1991, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and commencement :--(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Establishment of District Development Advisory
Committees (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
